build_graph_transducer: build a graph transducer using gtn.Graph with add_node and add_arc to model weighted finite-state transducers
test_forward_score: test the forward_score function on a gtn graph to compute the log-sum-exp of all path weights
test_viterbi_path: test the viterbi_path function to find the highest-scoring path through a weighted graph transducer
compose_graphs: compose two gtn graphs using gtn.compose to chain transducers and match input-output symbol pairs
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a gtn graph using gtn.remove to eliminate empty-symbol arcs
